basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a tech enthusiast from Seattle. I recently started exploring the world of smart home devices, which led me to discover HOOBS. My interests include emerging technologies, strategy games, and exploring genetic research. I'm typically online in the evenings, after my day job as a junior data analyst. In my free time, I enjoy playing mobile games like Art of War: Legions and occasionally dive into discussions around genetics and cultural topics. I'm single and enjoy spending time with my local community group.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in data analytics, having completed a bachelor's degree in Computer Science. My knowledge about smart home devices is mostly self-taught through online resources and community forums. I am also keenly interested in genetics, which I keep abreast of through the Genetic Counseling subreddit.
